verses.sanskrit: मातोवाच। नैव राज्ञा दरः कार्यो जातु कस्याञ्चिदापदि। अथ चेदपि दीर्णः स्यान्नैव वर्तेत दीर्णवत् ॥१॥
verses.english: The mother said By a king should fear never be entertained in whatever calamity he may fall; even if his heart should rend with fear he should not show that he had been stuck with fear.
verses.bhavadeepa: संभाव्यमेवैतदित्युपहासः । असंभावितमेतत् यच्छत्रौ विश्वासं कृत्वाऽपि राज्यं प्राप्नुयादिति ॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: दीर्णं हि दृष्ट्वा राजानं सर्वमेवानुदीर्यते। राष्ट्रं बलममात्याश्च पृथक्कुर्वन्ति ते मतीः ॥२॥
verses.english: Seeing a king struck with fear, all are struck with fear-the entire kingdom, the army, the ministers and the earth are divided into factions.
verses.bhavadeepa: नैवेति । दरो भयं जातु कदाचित् दीर्णो भीतः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: शत्रूनेके प्रपद्यन्ते प्रजहत्यपरे पुनः। अन्ये तु प्राजिहीर्षन्ति ये पुरस्ताद्विमानिताः ॥३॥
verses.english: One party takes the side of the enemy, another abandons the king, a third again rejoices namely those who have been treated insultingly.

verses.sanskrit: य एवात्यन्तसुहृदस्त एनं पर्युपासते। अशक्तयः स्वस्तिकामा बद्धवत्सा इला इव ॥४॥
verses.english: He, who is sincere well wisher, alone remains attached to his side a cow which wishers to free her calf which has been tied up, but is unable to do it.

verses.sanskrit: शोचन्तमनुशोचन्ति पतितानिव बान्धवान्। अपि ते पूजिताः पूर्वमपि ते सुहृदो मताः ॥५॥
verses.english: They grieve for their lord who is grieving as they would grieve for friends plunged into distress. You have got many friends as true as you could wish whom you had done honors before.
verses.bhavadeepa: इलाः धेनवः ‘इलाः धेनुः सहवत्सा न आगात्’ इति मन्त्रवर्णात् ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: ये राष्ट्रमभिमन्यन्ते राज्ञो व्यसनमीयुषः। मा दीदरस्त्वं सुहृदो मा त्वां दीर्णं प्रहासिषुः ॥६॥
verses.english: Who feel for your lost kingdom and who desire to have on themselves a portion of your troubles. Do not give way to fear; let not your friends abandon you, as they will do if you are struck with fear.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावं पौरुषं बुद्धिं जिज्ञासन्त्या मया तव। विदधत्या समाश्वासमुक्तं तेजोविवृद्धये ॥७॥
verses.english: Desiring to know your might, manliness and intelligence, has all this been said by me as also for supporting your failing courage, sustaining your hope and for enhancing your energy.
verses.bhavadeepa: ये राष्ट्रमस्मदीयमिदमस्माभी रक्षणीयं राजा च व्यसनादुद्धर्तव्य इति अभिमन्यन्ते अभिमानवन्तः । मा दीदरः मा विदारय ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: यदेतत्संविजानासि यदि सम्यग्ब्रवीम्यहम्। कृत्वाऽसौम्यमिवात्मानं जयायोत्तिष्ठ सञ्जय ॥८॥
verses.english: If you are confident that I have spoken the truth, then rise up, O Sanjaya, tranquilizing your mind with a view to gain victory.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति नः कोशनिचयो महान् ह्यविदितस्तव। तमहं वेद नान्यस्तमुपसंपादयामि ते ॥९॥
verses.english: We have got a large treasury unknown to you. I know that and no body else and I shall place it at your command.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ति नैकतमा भूयः सुहृदस्तव सञ्जय। सुखदुःखसहा वीर सङ्ग्रामादनिवर्तिनः ॥१०॥
verses.english: You have got many hence well wishers, O Sanjaya, who are heroes, competent equally to endure happiness and misery and who would not turn back from the field.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशा हि सहाया वै पुरुषस्य बुभूषतः। इष्टं जिहीर्षतः किञ्चित्सचिवाः शत्रुकर्शन ॥११॥
verses.english: Such are the fitting allies of a man seeking his welfare and desirous of attaining what he wants and are also good councillors, 0 chastiser of your foes.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यास्त्वीदृशकं वाक्यं श्रुत्वाऽपि स्वल्पचेतसः। तमस्त्वपागमत्तस्य सुचित्रार्थपदाक्षरम् ॥१२॥
verses.english: Kunti said Hearing this her speech pregnant with sense and consisting of weighty letters and words, the despair that had overtaken him, feeble-minded as he was, immediately vanquished.

verses.sanskrit:
पुत्र उवाच।
              उदके भूरियं धार्या मर्तव्यं प्रवणे मया। यस्य मे भवती नेत्री भविष्यद्भूतिदर्शिनी ॥१३॥
verses.english: The son said I shall rescue my kingdom that is sunk in water or die in the attempt-I, who have for my guide yourself who have a great knowledge of the future.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि वचनं त्वत्तः शुश्रूषुरपरापरम्। किञ्चित् किञ्चित् प्रतिवदंस्तूष्णीमासं मुहुर्मुहुः ॥१४॥
verses.english: I remained silent while hearing your words with the desire of hearing more from you and only spoke a few words by way of reply.
verses.bhavadeepa: उदके मज्जन्तीव भूः पित्र्यं राज्यम् । धूरितिपाठेऽपि स एवार्थः । इयं मया धार्या मग्नं राज्यं वा उद्धर्तव्यं प्रवणे प्रपाते वा युद्धाख्ये वा मर्तव्यं न तु एवमेव निर्व्यापारेण स्थेयम् । नेत्री शिक्षयित्री ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: अतृप्यन्नमृतस्येव कृच्छ्राल्लब्धस्य बान्धवात्। उद्यच्छाम्येष शत्रूणां नियमार्थं जयाय च ॥१५॥
verses.english: Like one unsatiated with nectar I am not satiated with hearing your words. Having gained friends in my distress behold I rise up for subjugating my enemies and gaining victories over them.
verses.bhavadeepa: अपरापरमपरमपरम् उत्तरोत्तरमिति यावत् । प्रतिवदन् प्रतिकूलं वदन् आयसं हृदयं तवेति पुत्रे निःस्नेहासीत्यादि ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: कुन्त्युवाच। सदश्व इव स क्षिप्तः प्रणुन्नो वाक्यसायकैः। तच्चकार तथा सर्वं यथावदनुशासनम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Kunti said Like a horse of good breed he became excited, being struck with these arrows in the shape of words and performed all that his mother had instructed him to do.
verses.bhavadeepa: बान्धवात् बन्धुतः उद्यच्छामि उद्यमं करोमि नियमार्थं निग्रहार्थं बान्धवानिति पाठे उद्यच्छामि धारयामि ॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: इदमुद्धर्षणं भीमं तेजोवर्धनमुत्तमम्। राजानं श्रावयेन्मन्त्री सीदन्तं शत्रुपीडितम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: A minister should make a king, who is depressed with despair being troubled by his enemies, hear of this story than which nothing is better in increasing energy and infusing fierce might.

verses.sanskrit: जयो नामेतिहासोऽयं श्रोतव्यो विजिगीषुणा। महीं विजयते क्षिप्रं श्रुत्वा शत्रूंश्च मर्दति ॥१८॥
verses.english: This story which is called Jaya (victory) should be heard by one who is desirous of victory; and hearing it one conquers the world speedily and vanquishes his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: इदं पुंसवनं चैव वीराजननमेव च। अभीक्ष्णं गर्भिणी श्रुत्वा ध्रुवं वीरं प्रजायते ॥१९॥
verses.english: This story makes a woman bring forth a son and a heroic, son; a pregnant woman hearing it repeated many times certainly bring forth a hero,

verses.sanskrit: विद्याशूरं तपःशूरं दानशूरं तपस्विनम्। ब्राह्म्या श्रिया दीप्यमानं साधुवादे च संमतम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Who is a hero in knowledge, a hero in devotion, a hero in liberality, a performer of austerities blazing with Brahmic prosperity and honored in speeches of the honest,
verses.bhavadeepa: पुंसवनं पुत्रप्रसवकरम् । वीराणामाजननं येन तद्वीराजननं प्रजायते जनयति ॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: अर्चिष्मन्तं बलोपेतं महाभागं महारथम्। धृतिमन्तमनाधृष्यं जेतारमपराजितम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Endued with fame, endued with might, of great attributes, a great car warrior, endued with wisdom, incapable of being vanquished, winner of victories, but himself sustaining no defeat;

verses.sanskrit: नियन्तारमसाधूनां गोप्तारं धर्मचारिणाम्। ईदृशं क्षत्रिया सूते वीरं सत्यपराक्रमम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Subjugator of the disreputable, a protector of those that practice virtues, such a son of true prowess does a Kshatriya lady bring forth.
